Teal lettering is artwork. Typed placement allocates one physical reserve counter on the block; control collects that same counter once, retaining collectedBy receipt. Counter ownership is distinct from three-block icons and player free/invested pools. Combined new-icon and block funding is checked before placement; collection works at empty reserve. Real source Search/capture, shared snapshots/events/views,11 tests in each mirror, sandbox replay/Undo/reset and editor pairing execute funded behavior. Placement reserve exhaustion remains T-RULES-031; record and strict official bundle acceptance remain provisional under T-RULES-047.

block/cleaner-b.note: One physical Cleaner (B) tile; language/layout sheets are aliases. H1 is the instruction banner and is not a space. Playable spaces are h2 hand−1, h3 normal circuit, h4 white defense1/2, h7 normal left, and the unlimited Cleaner B home covering h5/h6. All six entrances connect. White ICE6 is at V1; the single bonus fragment is at V3. The white outlined arrow runs from hand to circuit. PROTOCOL lettering is artwork. Capture places the one physical Cleaner B and its control card; tile placement alone does not. The white faces are defense, not space ICE.
